desc:
This is an old version of the mall! 

Play the new mall here: https://www.roblox.com/games/7406897155/Coded-Clothing-Mall-V4

Go shopping, try on avatar items & have fun with friends while creating your dream outfit! 🛍️
Anything bought in this game will stay in your inventory on Roblox!😊

Clothes, hair, hats, emotes, faces and so much more from different talented & experienced creators across Roblox can be found in this mall. 😍

With the in-game shopping bag, you can save clothing and accessories for your next visit for free! 🛍️
Purchase or try on the avatar items in-game by clicking on them! 👕👖🕶️👜

Main Developer: @codedcosmetics
Contributors: @RVVZ and @pastelicheart
UI Designer: @EGOTISMS
Game Thumbnail: @SoftGB
